description: This file defines the CustomDatatype interface in the org.openmrs.customdatatype package, specifying methods for custom data type implementations, such as configuration, persistence, retrieval, validation, and summary generation, used within the OpenMRS framework.

classes.name: CustomDatatype
classes.description: Interface representing a custom data type, defining methods for setting configuration, saving values, reference string conversions, validation, and generating text summaries.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets configuration parameters for the custom data type, such as regex patterns or other format specifics.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists a typed custom value and returns a reference string for future retrieval; can throw InvalidCustomValueException.

methods.name: getReferenceStringForValue
methods.description: Returns a reference string that represents the typed value, suitable for indexing or searching.

methods.name: fromReferenceString
methods.description: Converts a reference string back into the typed value, possibly throwing InvalidCustomValueException.

methods.name: getTextSummary
methods.description: Provides a concise, plain-text summary of a value, indicating if it is a full representation or just a summary.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if a given typed value is valid according to the datatype's rules.
